items.name: Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcxNjA5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5929f8a41a183746e6dfaa7436280533243ae518/logo_cropped_no_date.png) ## This is the FMC-Only competition of [Kewbz UK Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2026) #### As FMC is not being held at [Kewbz UK Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2026), this is your chance to become the UK's Fewest Moves Champion! Those that achieve a podium finish will be crowned during the awards ceremony in Birmingham * Please see all the tabs to see the locations and information of each venue. *\\* You do not need to attend UKC to become the UK FMC National Champion.* If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Spectators may attend for free, however this competition does not feature any traditional speedcubing events and is not recommended for newcomers.**
